single-strong.assembly: Keep the base and runner prompts and permissions; set model, small_model and every configured and built-in agent (build, plan, general, explore, compaction, title, summary and the embedded diff-reviewer) to the tier's resolved model.

single-cheap.assembly: Keep the base and runner prompts and permissions; set model, small_model and every configured and built-in agent (build, plan, general, explore, compaction, title, summary and the embedded diff-reviewer) to the tier's resolved model.

tiered.assembly: Resolve the base's model, small_model and agent models from the tiers file's roles; add the role agents and default_agent from roles to the runner, with the models that file sets, and set the embedded diff-reviewer to the sol tier's resolved model.
